svg.aria-label: Four clinic doors: pain clinic, gastroenterology, rheumatology and psychiatry, each with its own diagnosis. The same signal repeats across all four. A typical response, in blue, fades after a few repeats; the stuck response, in pink, stays at full strength the whole way.
